================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO RAU AFTER EFFECTS - YAM TSHIAB
Version 9.2.8  -  Lub Kaum Hli 2026
================================================================================

Panel no hais tau 132 YAM LUS lawm, muaj DEMON SLAYER THEMES tshiab nrog ib rab ntaj
txiav cov khawm koj nias, thiab muaj ob peb yam kho layout thiab Windows.

UA NTEJ KOJ PIB
- Nruab rau saum koj version tam sim no nrog koj lub ZXP installer li niaj zaus, ces rov pib dua
  After Effects ib zaug.
- Koj cov settings, theme, presets thiab expressions uas khaws cia tseem nyob.

TSHIAB: PANEL 132 YAM LUS
- Flex Settings > LUS tam sim no teev 132 yam lus, nrog lub thawv nrhiav. Xaiv
  ib yam thiab tag nrho panel hloov: tabs, khawm, tooltips, cov lus.
- Txhua yam lus yog AI txhais los ntawm panel lus Askiv, tsis yog txhais lo lus rau lo lus. Cov npe
  koj pom hauv koj project (npe layer, npe effect) tseem yog lus Askiv
  kom thiaj phim After Effects.
- Lub popup "yam tshiab" kuj txhais lawm, pib los ntawm version no.

TSHIAB: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
- Flex Settings > THEME SELECTOR muaj ib pab DEMON SLAYER tshiab nrog 11 theme:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen thiab Kokushibo.
- Txav mouse hla panel thiab theme tus khoom caum nws: dej,
  nplaim taws, xob laim, npauj npaim, nplooj paj, pos huab thiab lwm yam. Thaum mouse
  nres, nws ploj mus maj mam.
- Nias ib lub khawm thiab tus cim ntawd rab ntaj txiav nws. Tuav lub khawm sab laug
  ces nws txiav mus ntxiv; tuav li 2.5 vib nas this thiab nws tawg.
- Tsim kom sib: cov effect khiav thaum koj txav lossis nias xwb, thiab
  lawv sib dua los ntawm lawv tus kheej ntawm cov computer qeeb dua. Kaw AMBIENT EFFECTS
  hauv Theme Selector kom khaws cov xim xwb.

HLOOV: KHAWM TIAJ HAUV TXHUA THEME
- Cov khawm ua haujlwm thiab cov khawm tseem ceeb hauv cov theme xim tsis siv xim
  hloov saum mus rau hauv qab lawm. Lawv yog ib xim tiaj nrog ci mos mos, yog li lawv
  zoo huv dua thiab nyeem yooj yim dua.

KHO TAU
- Daim license thiab lub popup "yam tshiab" yuav qhib sib thaiv. Tam sim no
  lawv tsis sib thaiv li lawm, thiab badge HLOOV TSHIAB tsis npog cov khawm
  sab saum ntawm panel lawm.
- Ntawm UI SCALE 125% thiab 150%, qee lub window (xws li Flex Settings) siab dua
  panel, ua rau lub khawm kaw tawm ntawm qhov pom. Tam sim no txhua lub
  window haum txhua qhov loj.
- Windows: AutoCaptions yuav hais tias "NVIDIA DRIVER QUB HEEV RAU GPU
  CAPTIONS" ntawm cov card thiab driver tshiab (RTX 40 thiab 50 series). Tam sim no nws nyeem
  driver CUDA kev txhawb nqa raug thiab siv koj GPU.

TSIS HLOOV
- Licensing, activation thiab txhua qhov link ua haujlwm ib yam li ua ntej.
- Txhua lub tab thiab cuab yeej lwm yam ua haujlwm ib yam li hauv 9.2.7.

FLEX ULTIMATE RAU PREMIERE PRO - YAM TSHIAB
Version 2.2.8  -  Lub Kaum Hli 2026

CAPTION STACK captions tam sim no yog Motion Graphics templates EDITABLE nrog ib tug
editor tiag, muaj AUDIO STUDIO tshiab thiab MARK AUDIO BEATS, panel hais tau 132
YAM LUS, UI SCALE tuaj rau hauv ULTIMATE, thiab muaj DEMON SLAYER THEMES tshiab.

TSHIAB: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS UA TAU EDIT (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Captions tam sim no muab tso ua Motion Graphics templates uas edit tau (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, qhov default tshiab hauv Premiere Pro 2026). Tom qab muab tso,
  hloov tau txhua lo lus, font, xim, loj, chaw, glow, outline, box,
  animation lossis timing hauv Premiere lub Essential Graphics panel.
- Output > DUAB tseem muab txhua lo lus tso ua ib daim duab nrog qhov zoo li qub,
  yog koj nyiam li ntawd.
- Cov templates los nrog panel. Tsis tas rub tawm dab tsi.

- Preview tam sim no qhia koj daim video lub frame tiag hauv qab txhua caption.
- Rub ib lub caption kom txav nws, siv lub kaum kom hloov qhov loj thiab lub dot sab saum kom
  tig nws, nias ob zaug rau ib lo lus kom edit nws. WHOLE CAPTION txav txhua lo lus
  ua ke, ONE WORD txav ib lo lus xwb.
- Xaiv seb qhov hloov puas siv rau txhua caption lossis lub caption no xwb, thiab
  khaws cia koj cov layouts siv dua.
- 10 GLOW looks tshiab: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow thiab Superb.

  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse thiab lwm yam. Muab
  ntau tus effects ua ke li koj xav tau, kho lawv txoj kab dua lossis kaw ib qho.
- Reverb khaws nws tus tw: lub suab tseem nrov tom qab clip xaus, thiab nws raug muab tso kom
  tsis muaj dab tsi ntawm koj timeline raug sau tshaj.
- Cuab yeej: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
